editorial.blurb: Dastarkhwan serves authentic Hyderabadi cuisine that reviewers say rivals the real thing in India, with standout biryanis and haleem that keep diners coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Hyderabadi Goat Biryani — reviewers consistently praise its impossibly soft rice and call it among the best biryani available in the area.
